cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(stellar_dvdread C)
set(DVDREAD_VERSION_MAJOR 7)
set(DVDREAD_VERSION_MINOR 1)
set(DVDREAD_VERSION_MICRO 1)
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/dvdread")
configure_file(src/dvdread/version.h.in "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/dvdread/version.h" @ONLY)
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/config.h" "#define HAVE_DLFCN_H 1\n#define HAVE_DIRENT_H 1\n#define HAVE_SYS_PARAM_H 1\n#define HAVE_STATIC_ASSERT 1\n#define UNUSED __attribute__((unused))\n")
add_library(dvdread STATIC src/bitreader.c src/dvd_input.c src/dvd_reader.c src/dvd_udf.c
    src/ifo_read.c src/logger.c src/md5.c src/nav_read.c src/file/file_posix.c)
set_target_properties(dvdread PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON C_STANDARD 11)
target_compile_definitions(dvdread PRIVATE _DEFAULT_SOURCE _LARGEFILE64_SOURCE DVDREAD_API_EXPORT)
target_include_directories(dvdread PUBLIC src "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}" PRIVATE src/dvdread)
target_link_libraries(dvdread PUBLIC dl)
